StatDef.label: artifact slots
StatDef.description: How many artifacts carried in the inventory are active at once. One by default; suits add more.

StatDef.label: gear carrying capacity
StatDef.description: Extra mass this creature can carry in its inventory and in caravans thanks to its gear (exoskeletons, backpacks).

ThingDef.label: "Leshy" ghillie suit
ThingDef.description: A light camouflage cloak with a hood. Barely protects, but does not slow its wearer down.

ThingDef.label: ghillie hood
ThingDef.description: A hood covered in fabric strips. Breaks up the outline of the head.

ThingDef.label: drifter's leather jacket
ThingDef.description: A worn leather jacket with sewn-in protective panels. Cheap, light and better than nothing.

ThingDef.label: knit beanie
ThingDef.description: A warm knit beanie. Keeps the head warm, protects nothing.

ThingDef.label: "Walker" coverall
ThingDef.description: A reliable all-round suit for trips into the Zone: armored panels, sealed seams and a rack for two artifacts.

ThingDef.label: field hood
ThingDef.description: A cloth hood. Keeps off rain and a little dust.

ThingDef.label: "Old Hand" armored coverall
ThingDef.description: A veteran's suit with extra plates and a sealed hood. Heavier, but holds up against both bullets and anomalies.

ThingDef.label: steel helmet, woodland cover
ThingDef.description: A classic steel helmet in a fabric cover, with a chin strap.

ThingDef.label: "Sentry" field uniform
ThingDef.description: Everyday uniform of Duty patrols with a light armored vest.

ThingDef.label: patrol cap
ThingDef.description: A cloth field cap with a short visor.

ThingDef.label: "Bastion" armored suit
ThingDef.description: Heavy armor issued to Duty fighters. Stops bullets and blows well, but weighs its wearer down.

ThingDef.label: black steel helmet
ThingDef.description: A classic steel helmet in a fabric cover, with a chin strap.

ThingDef.label: "Hammer" assault kit
ThingDef.description: Assault armor for storming mutant lairs. Nearly bulletproof and very heavy.

ThingDef.label: assault helmet with armored visor
ThingDef.description: A heavy helmet with a clear armored face shield. Covers the whole head.

ThingDef.label: "Breeze" light suit
ThingDef.description: A light suit for fast raids, with a rack for two artifacts.

ThingDef.label: green balaclava
ThingDef.description: A knit balaclava that leaves only the eyes open. Covers the whole head.

ThingDef.label: "Liberty" coverall
ThingDef.description: A light combat suit favored by Freedom: good anomaly protection and room for three artifacts.

ThingDef.label: high-cut tactical helmet
ThingDef.description: A high-cut tactical helmet with side rails and a mount for a device.

ThingDef.label: "Free Guard" armored coverall
ThingDef.description: Heavy armor of Freedom's best fighters, balanced between firefights and the Zone.

ThingDef.label: steel helmet, green cover
ThingDef.description: A classic steel helmet in a fabric cover, with a chin strap.

ThingDef.label: black leather jacket
ThingDef.description: A long black coat with a few steel plates sewn into the lining.

ThingDef.label: flat cap
ThingDef.description: A worn flat cap.

ThingDef.label: "Touring" armored coat
ThingDef.description: A heavy leather coat over a stolen armored vest.

ThingDef.label: dark hood
ThingDef.description: A cloth hood. Keeps off rain and a little dust.

ThingDef.label: cordon field uniform
ThingDef.description: Standard field uniform of the cordon troops with a light vest.

ThingDef.label: army field cap
ThingDef.description: A cloth field cap with a short visor.

ThingDef.label: army armor kit
ThingDef.description: Standard body armor of the cordon troops. Built for firefights, not for anomalies.

ThingDef.label: army steel helmet
ThingDef.description: A classic steel helmet in a fabric cover, with a chin strap.

ThingDef.label: special forces assault kit
ThingDef.description: Assault armor of the special units. Excellent against bullets, poor against the Zone.

ThingDef.label: special forces visor helmet
ThingDef.description: A heavy helmet with a clear armored face shield. Covers the whole head.

ThingDef.label: acolyte's vestment
ThingDef.description: A pale suit of Monolith acolytes. Protects the mind better than the body.

ThingDef.label: pale hood
ThingDef.description: A cloth hood. Keeps off rain and a little dust.

ThingDef.label: "Tablet" armor
ThingDef.description: Pale armor of the Monolith fanatics. Strongly shields the mind and the body from the Zone.

ThingDef.label: shielded helmet
ThingDef.description: A tactical helmet with a psi shielding coil and a small antenna.

ThingDef.label: "Contract" tactical suit
ThingDef.description: A light tactical suit for quick contracts.

ThingDef.label: cap with headset
ThingDef.description: A cap with a radio headset.

ThingDef.label: "Hire" combat suit
ThingDef.description: A professional combat suit: well-balanced protection from bullets and anomalies.

ThingDef.label: tactical helmet, urban cover
ThingDef.description: A high-cut tactical helmet with side rails and a mount for a device.

ThingDef.label: "Guarantor" heavy kit
ThingDef.description: Heavy armor for well-paid jobs deep in the Zone.

ThingDef.label: heavy visor helmet
ThingDef.description: A heavy helmet with a clear armored face shield. Covers the whole head.

ThingDef.label: "Lab Tech" chemical suit
ThingDef.description: A sealed research suit. Weak against bullets, but the best protection from radiation, chemicals and fire.

ThingDef.label: gas mask hood
ThingDef.description: A rubberized hood with a panoramic gas mask and a side filter. The working headgear of Zone scientists. Covers the whole head.

ThingDef.label: "Barrier" isolating suit
ThingDef.description: A top-class research suit with its own air supply. The best protection against anomalies the Zone has seen.

ThingDef.label: isolating helmet
ThingDef.description: A sealed helmet with a wide clear visor and a breathing hose. Fully isolates the wearer. Covers the whole head.

ThingDef.label: exoskeleton armor shell
ThingDef.description: Heavy armor plating made to be worn with an exoskeleton frame. Holds five artifacts. Without the frame it is very heavy.

ThingDef.label: heavy helmet with gas mask
ThingDef.description: A heavy steel helmet with bolted cheek plates, a neck guard and an attached gas mask with a side filter. Covers the whole head.

ThingDef.label: "Ram" assault armor shell
ThingDef.description: Assault plating for an exoskeleton. The strongest armor in the Zone, and the heaviest.

ThingDef.label: armored helmet with gas mask
ThingDef.description: A thicker armored version of the heavy helmet with a gas mask and a chin plate. Covers the whole head.

ThingDef.label: stalker helmet
ThingDef.description: A steel helmet with a padded liner. Also slightly dulls psychic pressure.

ThingDef.label: psi helmet
ThingDef.description: A helmet with a built-in psi shield circuit. Protects the mind from psychic fields and the emission.

ThingDef.label: gas mask
ThingDef.description: A rubber gas mask with a filter. Keeps out radioactive dust and toxic fumes. Can be worn under a helmet.

ThingDef.label: lead container
ThingDef.description: A heavy lead-lined box for an artifact. Each container carried in the inventory blocks the radiation of one active artifact (the strongest first), while the artifact keeps working.

ThingDef.label: repair kit
ThingDef.description: Patches, sealant and spare plates. Restores 40% of a worn Zone suit. In the inventory it is used automatically when the suit drops below 70%; right-click it on the ground to pick it up and repair right away.

ThingDef.label: exoskeleton frame
ThingDef.description: A powered frame for the legs, hips and shoulders with a power unit on the back. Worn over any armor: carries a huge load, but slows its owner.

ThingDef.label: assault exoskeleton frame
ThingDef.description: A reinforced frame with heavy hydraulics. Carries even more and hits harder in melee.
